versions.text: Criterion: Verify that yaw control forces in waveoff (go-around) are safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.3.7 Yaw control forces in waveoff (go-around) (see table LXV for guidance). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation. Additional References: 14 CFR 23.143 General 14 CFR 25.143 General

Standard: The pedal control force required to maintain straight flight during waveoff (go-around) due to thrust, configuration, and airspeed changes is no worse than Level 2 as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Yaw Control Forces in Waveoff (Go-Around) paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's yaw control force during waveoff (go-around) as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Yaw Control Forces in Waveoff (Go-Around) paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the yaw control forces in during waveoff (go-around) as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Yaw Control Forces in Waveoff (Go- Around) paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the yaw control forces in during waveoff (go-around) as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Yaw Control Forces in Waveoff (Go-Around) paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states and environmental conditions.
